items.item:
9. A13-6: An element recorded `outcome_unknown` keeps its dependants waiting while its
   EffectAttempt is `unknown`; resolved `applied` for a binding without output
   ports — which has no dependants, since an edge starts only at an output port
   — the element counts succeeded and the run continues to its end; resolved
   `applied` for a binding with output ports, its dependants conclude
   `upstream_failed`; its NodeExecution keeps `outcome_unknown` throughout.
   [witness: verification:kernel_a13_resolved_unknown_conclusion]
statements: A13-6: conclusion(element) = status(node_execution) unless resolved(outcome_unknown) -> A11

verdicts.why: The test detects that an unknown attempt leaves the downstream node unexecuted, then verifies that resolving it as applied with outputs fails the run and concludes the dependant upstream_failed, while resolving the outputless binding succeeds. Calls to unknown_element before and after resolution assert that the NodeExecution remains outcome_unknown throughout.
